%==================================================================
% ATS variant — header (DO NOT EDIT)
% Name + tagline + single-line contact. No photo, no icons, no tables.
% Fields disabled with % in config/personal.tex are skipped, "|" auto-hides.
%==================================================================
\begin{center}
  {\NameFontSize \cvName \par}
  \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvTagline}{}}{}{\vspace{2pt}{\SmallFontSize \cvTagline \par}}
  \vspace{2pt}
  {\SmallFontSize
    \cvNeedSepfalse
    \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvLocation}{}}{}{\cvItem{\cvLocation}}%
    \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvPhone}{}}{}{\cvItem{\cvPhone}}%
    \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvEmail}{}}{}{\cvItem{\href{mailto:\cvEmail}{\cvEmail}}}%
    \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvGithubUrl}{}\AND\equal{\cvLinkedinUrl}{}\AND\equal{\cvWebsiteUrl}{}}{}{%
      \ifcvNeedSep\\\cvNeedSepfalse\fi
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvGithubUrl}{}}{}{\cvItem{\href{https://\cvGithubUrl}{\cvGithubLabel}}}%
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvLinkedinUrl}{}}{}{\cvItem{\href{https://\cvLinkedinUrl}{\cvLinkedinLabel}}}%
      \ifthenelse{\equal{\cvWebsiteUrl}{}}{}{\cvItem{\href{https://\cvWebsiteUrl}{\cvWebsiteLabel}}}%
    }%
  \par}
\end{center}
\vspace{-4pt}
